description: This file contains template functions implementing coordinate transformations, clipping, reflection, and source index computations used in grid sampling operations in PyTorch. It includes logic for normalizing coordinates, handling padding modes, and calculating gradients for backward passes.

methods.name: scalar_t grid_sampler_unnormalize(scalar_t coord,int64_t size,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Unnormalizes a coordinate from [-1, 1] to pixel index range based on 'align_corners' flag.

methods.name: scalar_t grid_sampler_unnormalize_set_grad(scalar_t coord,int64_t size,bool align_corners,scalar_t * grad_in)
methods.description: Unnormalizes a coordinate and computes its gradient component for backward pass.

methods.name: scalar_t clip_coordinates(scalar_t in,int64_t clip_limit)
methods.description: Clips a coordinate to the image boundary.

methods.name: scalar_t clip_coordinates_set_grad(scalar_t in,int64_t clip_limit,scalar_t * grad_in)
methods.description: Clips coordinate with gradient computation for backward pass.

methods.name: scalar_t reflect_coordinates(scalar_t in,int64_t twice_low,int64_t twice_high)
methods.description: Reflects coordinates into valid range using reflection pattern.

methods.name: scalar_t reflect_coordinates_set_grad(scalar_t in,int64_t twice_low,int64_t twice_high,scalar_t * grad_in)
methods.description: Reflects coordinates with gradient computation for backward pass.

methods.name: scalar_t compute_coordinates(scalar_t coord,int64_t size,GridSamplerPadding padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Maps normalized coordinate to boundary-corrected coordinate based on padding mode.

methods.name: scalar_t grid_sampler_compute_source_index(scalar_t coord,int64_t size,GridSamplerPadding padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Computes source pixel index from normalized coordinate for sampling.

methods.name: scalar_t grid_sampler_compute_source_index_set_grad(scalar_t coord,int64_t size,GridSamplerPadding padding_mode,bool align_corners,scalar_t * grad_in)
methods.description: Computes source pixel index with gradient info for backward pass.

methods.name: bool within_bounds_2d(int64_t h,int64_t w,int64_t H,int64_t W)
methods.description: Checks if 2D coordinates are within image bounds.

methods.name: bool within_bounds_3d(int64_t d,int64_t h,int64_t w,int64_t D,int64_t H,int64_t W)
methods.description: Checks if 3D coordinates are within volume bounds.

methods.name: scalar_t get_value_bounded(const scalar_t * data,scalar_t x,scalar_t y,int64_t W,int64_t H,int64_t sW,int64_t sH,GridSamplerPadding padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from data array at computed coordinate, considering boundary conditions.

methods.name: void safe_add_2d(scalar_t * data,int64_t h,int64_t w,int64_t sH,int64_t sW,int64_t H,int64_t W,scalar_t delta)
methods.description: Safely adds delta to 2D data at specified location if within bounds.

methods.name: void safe_add_3d(scalar_t * data,int64_t d,int64_t h,int64_t w,int64_t sD,int64_t sH,int64_t sW,int64_t D,int64_t H,int64_t W,scalar_t delta)
methods.description: Safely adds delta to 3D data at specified location if within bounds.

methods.name: void add_value_bounded(scalar_t * data,scalar_t x,scalar_t y,int64_t W,int64_t H,int64_t sW,int64_t sH,scalar_t delta,GridSamplerPadding padding_mode,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Adds a delta to data array at coordinate after boundary adjustments.

methods.name: void get_cubic_coefficients_grad(scalar_t coeffs[4],scalar_t t)
methods.description: Calculates gradient coefficients for cubic interpolation.
